name: Paranoia
overview: Scripture addresses paranoia by encouraging believers to trust confidently in God's presence and protection. The LORD is portrayed as a faithful companion who will neither fail nor forsake His people, empowering them to be strong and courageous without fear or dismay. Even in the darkest and most threatening circumstances, such as walking through the valley of the shadow of death, God's comforting presence dispels fear. Those who seek refuge in the Almighty find deliverance from all fears, dwelling securely under His shadow and strength.
